comment: The plan called for 4 mid-tier + 1 frontier worker. This environment only has ONE cloud model reachable (minimax-m3:cloud) plus a tiny 0.5B local model (qwen2.5:0.5b). The 0.5B is too small for coding tasks; we ship the one-worker config and document the limitation in RESULTS.md.

workers.description: Cloud model via the local Ollama cloud router. Frontier-tier reasoning.
